en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large, two‑storey institutional building behind a high wall and decorative fence. The structure has many rectangular windows, a central arched entrance, and a long façade, suggesting a school or asylum. In the foreground is a street with telegraph poles, and a child or small figure standing by the corner of the wall. At the top of the image is printed text: a numbered caption on the left and the publisher's name on the right.
